sentence_timing.text: Standing as the only largely intact Wonder of the Ancient World, the Great Pyramid remains a testament to human ingenuity.
Commissioned by Pharaoh Khufu during the 4th Dynasty, this monumental tomb rose on the Giza Plateau around 2580 BCE.
Under the direction of architect Hemiunu, workers labored for over two decades to assemble 2.3 million limestone blocks.
Contrary to myths of slave labor, evidence reveals a skilled, paid workforce of up to 30,000 men organized into disciplined gangs.
These laborers utilized copper chisels and stone pounders to extract massive materials, including granite transported 800 kilometers from Aswan.
To reach heights of over 146 meters, engineers likely employed complex ramp systems and wooden levers.
Precision was paramount, as the structure is aligned to true north with remarkable stellar accuracy.
Internal features like the Grand Gallery and relieving chambers showcase sophisticated structural engineering.
For 3,800 years, this limestone marvel stood as the tallest man-made structure on Earth.
